Package com.arthroverse.vf17.detection

Class YOLOv8Detector

java.lang.Object
com.arthroverse.vf17.detection.YOLOv8Detector
public class YOLOv8Detector extends Object
Provides YOLOv8 inference using ONNX Runtime and converts raw model outputs into filtered detection boxes, including Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS).
Version:
1.0
Author:
Dinh Hieu Minh (25minh.dh2@vinuni.edu.vn)

      private final float confThreshold
      This is called the Confidence Threshold, where certain objects with certain detection confidence will be keep. In this situation, all objects with detection confidence >= 0.25
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • iouThreshold

      private final float iouThreshold
      This is called Intersection over Union threshold

      A same object might be detected twice or more with slightly different boxes. Therefore, Interfection over Union threshold is used to determine the amount of overlap between the detection boxes and if they are in the same classes => keep the highest confidence box

      See Also:

    • postProcess

      private List<YOLOv8Detector.Detection> postProcess(float[][] output, int originalWidth, int originalHeight)
      This method will return a list consisting of Detection boxes which has been created after the process of raw output from the ONNX runtime

      This method will determine if the confidence is strictly higher than the confThreshold and then create a new Detection box instance and add it to the returning list

    • applyNMS

      private List<YOLOv8Detector.Detection> applyNMS(List<YOLOv8Detector.Detection> detections)
      This method will be used to apply the Intersection over Union threshold mechanism commonly known as (Non-maximum Suppression). After determined which detection boxes has the highest confidence, NMS will be used to eliminate duplication boxes based on the iOu threshold declared above
